title: About me
text: In 2013–2014, I held a Fulbright fellowship at the University of Pennsylvania. I’ve always been interested in foreign languages and linguistics, which led me to a Ph.D. in Linguistics (Romance Languages) at the University of Georgia. During my time as a graduate student, I enjoyed learning about computational approaches for text analysis and took courses on quantitative methods, finite state machines, sociolinguistics and field methods. I have extensive teaching experience, and more recently I completed The Carpentries Instructor Training Program to integrate data science into my classes, workshops and peer mentoring.
